courses.title: STT-Intercultural Comm
courses.description: An introduction to intercultural communication, or the study and practice of communication across cultural contexts. Exploring various world languages first-hand as a means of understanding culture, values, and worldviews, students will develop skills in negotiating the connections among language, communication styles, everyday cultural practices, and cultural perspectives that shape meaning.
